command:
set -euo pipefail; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/titan-migrate-test-XXXXXX); git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt/titan-mx-mc-person-continuity-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$T/repo"; python3 - "$HOME/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db" "$T/unified.db" "$HOME/.local/share/agentzero/titan_mx.db" "$T/legacy.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
for src,dst in [(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]),(sys.argv[3],sys.argv[4])]:
 s=sqlite3.connect('file:'+src+'?mode=ro',uri=True); d=sqlite3.connect(dst); s.backup(d); d.close(); s.close()

cd "$T/repo"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/f2wp1207_titan_mx_migrate_legacy.py --unified "$T/unified.db" --legacy "$T/legacy.db"; python3 - "$T/unified.db" "$T/legacy.db" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
u=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); l=sqlite3.connect('file:'+sys.argv[2]+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
for t in ['titan_mx_pulse','titan_mx_transition','titan_mx_claim','titan_mx_pattern','titan_mx_hyperblock','titan_mx_mirror']:
 a=u.execute(f'select count(*) from {t}').fetchone()[0]; b=l.execute(f'select count(*) from {t}').fetchone()[0]; print(t,a,b); assert a>=b
print('receipt',u.execute("select status from f2_titan_mx_migration order by created_at desc limit 1").fetchone()[0]); print('topology',u.execute("select storage_topology from f2_titan_mx_runtime where singleton=1").fetchone()[0]); u.close(); l.close()
